answer: Lantern Ledger challenge: each identity must publish a fresh, verifiable hardware-attested nonce at unpredictable intervals announced only through a rotating beacon (the lantern). A falcon probe then demands a signed response within a tight window; duplicates sharing one physical root produce correlated timing signatures that reveal cloning. The meadow of registered identities is periodically re-attested, and every failed or late response forfeits the identity's full registration deposit plus a re-entry delay.
